name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back with one heel close to your hips
Straighten the other leg in line with the bent knee
Push through the planted heel to raise your hips level
Lower slowly without letting the free side drop first

The free leg stays straight with its hip tied to the working hip, matching cues 2 and 4.
